note: GA DNR state park run by Coral Hospitality (Little Ocmulgee Lodge) beside a 256-acre CCC-built lake with a white sandy beach, fishing docks and a boat ramp. The campground sits among oak trees and Spanish moss, inland of the lakeside cabins. --Claude
summary: The lodge's iqwebbook engine now lists and prices all 54 campsites (on 2026-10-12 it said 'please call hotel'): booking platform phone -> operator with engine URL. Fees added: $47 weeknight for a 30 A water site up to $77 Saturday for 50 A full hookup; military/senior 20% off. Hookups 50 A/water/sewer, 54 sites (51 x 40 ft, 3 x 20 ft), 12 pull-throughs confirmed from site names. Note: dropped the wrong 'Reservable via ReserveAmerica', the 2026-10-12 phone-only paragraph, hookups and counts. Not waterfront stands: the lakeshore row is cabins, RV pads sit ~150-250 m inland on imagery. Pin within the campground. State park, so no price gate.
flags: Phone: stored 1-800-864-7275 is the statewide reservations line, which doesn't book this park. The lodge gives 'RESERVATIONS: 229-868-7474' (Google agrees). Suggest 229-868-7474.

Booking policy: the entry inherits the state:GA booking row (13-month window, 4pm cutoff, weekend 2-night / holiday 3-night minimums, 14-night max), but that row's note says the lodge parks (incl. Little Ocmulgee) handle 'their reservations and policies' themselves and the lodge publishes none of those rules. Suggest policy_ref 'none' for booking (keeping the $10 ParkPass in the fees note), as done for 4516 Amicalola Falls and 4529 Georgia Veterans.
